game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace, a terrace under the aurora: the snow ranger must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Boolean Guards: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints.
theme: Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace: a terrace under the aurora
core_gameplay_loop: In Aurora Terrace, repeat each round: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the guards value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about guards to power up the snow ranger and open the larder door.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Boolean Guards
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Guards' (Week 6 slot 10), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Aurora Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guards changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Aurora Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
